blocks.heading: Order the Best Birthday Flower Delivery
blocks.bodyHtml:
Brighten their day with the perfect birthday flowers from Teleflora. We have birthday gifts for him and birthday flowers for her, plus birthday bouquets for occasions like a Sweet 16 or Quinceanera. For an extra special birthday flowers delivery, you can even add a box of chocolates or a birthday balloon. Teleflora's Happy Birthday flower arrangements come in various price ranges and are made up of multiple types of flowers, giving you ultimate flexibility when looking for birthday gift ideas for everyone in your life. We even have birth month flowers if you want to give a personalized birthday gift this year.

blocks.heading: Send Birthday Flowers or Plants Anytime You Need
blocks.bodyHtml: If you need same-day flower delivery for birthday flowers or plants, we have you covered. Place your order before 2:00 p.m., Monday - Friday, or by 12:00 p.m. on Saturday or Sunday (in your recipient's time zone) and we can deliver your arrangement that day. When you check out, remember to set up a gift reminder so that next year you can wish them "Happy Birthday" with another magnificent birthday gift delivery from Teleflora!
